text: dsh-subagent-fork-lite 是用于 DSH 的子 agent provider，在 ctx.subagents 注册可配置的 fork-lite 名称。它从父 agent 会话中截取最近若干轮已完成对话，排除尚未结束的当前轮，并将事件序号整理为连续编号后作为子 agent 的初始上下文。可通过配置调整继承轮数，也可设置为零以不继承历史。适合希望控制子 agent 初始上下文范围、同时保留近期对话信息的 DSH 工作流；无需额外 API 密钥或外部服务。

dsh-subagent-fork-lite registers a configurable subagent provider on DSH. It seeds a child with selected completed turns from the parent session, omits the unfinished turn, and renumbers events for the child. Set the limit to zero to pass no history. No extra API key or external service is required.
想让 DSH 启动子 agent 时只带上父会话最近几轮已完成对话。
如何限制新子任务继承的聊天上下文长度，避免传入整段历史？
I want a child agent to start with only the most recent completed turns from its parent session.
dsh-subagent-fork-lite 的功能「限定继承轮次」：启动子 agent 时截取父会话最近 N 个已完成轮次，并将事件序号重排后作为初始 seed。
dsh-subagent-fork-lite 的功能「排除未完成轮次」：只保留最后一个 turn/end 之前的完整历史前缀；尚未结束的父轮次不会进入子 agent seed。

dsh-subagent-fork-lite README · dsh-subagent-fork-lite：In-process DeepSeek Harness subagent provider that seeds each child with a **bounded window** of the parent’s completed conversation — the last N finished turns — instead of the entire transcript.

Registered by default as `fork-lite` on `ctx.subagents`.

dsh-subagent-fork-lite README · Features：- **Turn-window seed** — configure how many completed parent turns the child inherits (`maxCompletedTurns`)
- **Stable mid-session cuts** — the open (in-flight) parent turn is never seeded; only balanced history through the last `turn/end`
- **Valid session seeds** — window events are renumbered so `seq` is contiguous from `0` (including remapped `sourceEventSeqs`)
- **In-process child** — depth limit, tool filter, persona, structured output, and per-start `agentOptions`
- **Context inheritance flag** — advertises `inheritsParentContext: true` when a seed is used
- **Named presets** — mount multiple instances with different `providerName` / `maxCompletedTurns` values

No commands, session projections, or client UI.

dsh-subagent-fork-lite README · How seeding works：1. Read the parent session log through the last `turn/end` (completed-turn prefix).
2. Keep only the last `maxCompletedTurns` of those turns.
3. Renumber event `seq` values to `0…k` so the child session accepts the seed.
4. Hand the seed to the in-process run driver; the child’s first user message is your `prompt`.

The child then runs in its own session. Later parent turns are not shared live — the seed is a one-time snapshot at start.

dsh-subagent-fork-lite README · What the seed contains：Within the kept turns, the child receives the parent’s logged events (user/assistant messages, tool calls/results, turn markers, and other events in that window). Surface history derived from those events is what the model sees.

dsh-subagent-fork-lite README · What it does not contain：- Parent turns older than the window
- The parent’s current open turn
- Custom or synthetic messages defined outside the parent log

dsh-subagent-fork-lite README · Capabilities：| Capability | Supported |
|---|---|
| `agentOptions` | yes |
| `outputSchema` | yes |
| `depthLimit` | yes |
| `toolFilter` | yes |
| `persona` | yes |
| Continuable prep (`prepareContinuable`) | yes (seed captured once at creation) |

dsh-subagent-fork-lite README · Known limitations：- Seed policy is Cordis config only — not a field on each `start()` call. Use multiple mounted provider names for discrete budgets.
- Window size is measured in **completed turns**, not characters or tokens.
- A window that includes surface replaces whose `sourceEventSeqs` point outside the window cannot be renumbered and will fail seed construction.
- On `0.1.6-alpha.1+`, synchronous `session.snapshotEvents()` is deprecated; this provider still uses it (same deferred migration as stock `fork`).
- Fresh AGENTS.md / runtime injects after start are separate from the seed (`agent/pre-step`); callers that need isolation must filter those themselves.
